title: Single-business health used stale unanswered-review source
original_report: The LocalOS mini-app showed 5 unanswered reviews for Organica after the current Yandex review snapshot contained 2.
expected: The single-business health endpoint returns 2 unanswered reviews from the current Yandex snapshot.
actual: The endpoint returned 5 from the legacy yandex_business-only query.
environment: Python 3.11.7 on macOS arm64; Flask test client with deterministic database boundary fixture.
reproduction: A focused API test supplies a legacy count of 5 and a current attention-row count of 2, then calls /api/network/health for one business.
root_cause: The single-business branch bypassed the current-snapshot query and counted only source=yandex_business without the is_current filter.
fix_summary: Load _network_attention_rows once and use its current unanswered-review count for both single-business and network responses.
why_causal: The corrected branch now reads the exact current-snapshot value that previously appeared only in attention rows.

reproduction_files.summary: Approved Gate 1 regression test for legacy-versus-current counts.

fix_files.summary: Approved Gate 2 change reusing current attention rows.

checks.name: Exact regression test
checks.detail: The same command changed from exit 1 to exit 0.

limitations: The regression fixture validates the API contract without a live authenticated browser session.
residual_risks: Other review-summary services that do not filter is_current require separate review and approval.
notes: No schema, permissions, or external-write behavior changed.
